title: lora_large_ensemble

ensemble._note: Weight on the first member (v5) from 0 to 1 in steps of 0.1; w = 1 is v5 alone, w = 0 the CNN alone, so validation also reports each member on its own.

validation._note: Same split procedure, seed and settings as v5. gamma is in log-probability units here (both members are on the log-prob scale), so the grid is 0-15 in steps of 0.1; v5's 0.0725 cosine corresponds to 7.25.
